data.body:
Change 1794 PS2 pushed (commit 9addf3f125c1, rebased onto 32eee274c7) — reworking the Verified -1 + two substantive advisories.

CI blocker: tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_transition_reason_honest_3803.py asserted transition_core has NO close_reason param — an invariant fc20 deliberately obsoletes. Rewrote the guard to pin ticket 3803's actual concern (reason honesty, nothing silently accepted-and-dropped) under the new contract: close_reason is keyword-only with empty default; a close without close_reason persists no close_reason key; close_reason alongside a non-reason class (bug/regression probe) is DISCARDED at the write; the one admitted shape (obsolete/wontfix) persists it. Enforced write-side: transition_core now stamps close_reason only when close_class is in REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES.

Advisory 1: _lib_writes.transition previously derived close_reason from (force, reason) unconditionally of class — a library close with reason + non-admin class would have persisted what the CLI refuses. Now gated: admits_close_reason = not (force or force_close) and close_class in REASON_REQUIRED_CLASSES. Pinned at the transition_compute boundary by test_library_close_reason_is_gated_on_the_admitting_class (spy asserts close_reason='') plus persisted-state assert, so it holds independently of transition_core's backstop.

Advisory 3: added test_forced_administrative_close_accepts_force_reason_as_justification[obsolete|wontfix] — --force=<note> satisfies the reason requirement (force_close_reason arm of close_class_refusal); persists force_close_reason, close_class, and NO close_reason. Also added test_library_close_persists_the_reason_for_a_reason_required_class.

Mutation sanity: reverting the transition_core stamp gate and the _lib_writes gate each KILLED by the new tests (2/2). Targeted suites 74/74 green post-rebase; make lint clean (ratchet new=0 increased=0); make typecheck clean (542 files).
